items.exampleEn: It is cold. Put on your coat.
This jacket has a lot of pockets.
My coat has big black buttons.
items.exampleZh: 我的大衣有黑色的大鈕扣。

items.exampleEn: I think this hat is ugly.
She is wearing a short skirt.

items.sentenceEn: Put on your coat and cap.

items.audioEn: This jacket is not ugly, but it is too big for me.
items.audioZh: 這件夾克不醜，但對我來說太大了。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得這件夾克怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: That little dog is very cute.
He looks handsome in that jacket.
items.sentenceZh: 他穿那件夾克看起來很帥。

items.stemEn: It is very cold today. Wear a warm ____.
items.stemZh: 今天很冷，穿件保暖的大衣。

items.stemEn: I can't close my jacket. A ____ is gone.
items.stemZh: 我的夾克掉了一顆鈕扣，所以沒辦法扣好。

items.passageEn: Emma goes shopping with her mother. Emma wants a short skirt and a red jacket. Her mother likes a long coat with big buttons, but Emma thinks it is ugly. In the end, they buy a cute cap for Emma's little brother.
items.passageZh: Emma 和媽媽去逛街。Emma 想要一件短裙和一件紅色夾克。媽媽喜歡一件有大鈕扣的長大衣，但 Emma 覺得那件很醜。最後，她們幫 Emma 的弟弟買了一頂可愛的帽子。

rubricZh: 形容詞 new 放在名詞前面（例如 your new jacket）
「很好看」可用 is nice、looks good、looks great 等

items.instructionZh: 用 cute 造一個句子，說說你覺得很可愛的人、動物或東西。
referenceEn: My little sister is very cute.
I think your cat is cute.
rubricZh: cute 可放在 be 動詞或 look 等動詞後面，也可放在名詞前面（例如 is cute、looks cute、a cute dog）
動詞配合主詞（例如 My sister is、Your cat looks）
